data.name: Asjad
data.gender_notes: Asjad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who defends, fights, and protects. The name Asjad carries the meaning “Defender, Fighter, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asjad usually hope their child will grow to embody defender, fighter, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are warriors of faith, protecting their community and values
data.etymology: Asjad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Defender, Fighter, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asjad total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أَسْجَاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأَسْمَاءُ الَّتِي تَشِيرُ إِلَى السَّلامِ وَالتَّقَدُّمِ، وَهِيَ أَحْوَالٌ تَعَبِّقُ لِلتَّغَلُّبِ عَلَى الرَّذائلِ وَتَحَيُّنُ التَّصَنُّعِ لِلجَبَّارِ وَالشَاكِرِ، وَهِيَ مُشَمِّرةٌ بِالنَوْعَينِ الَّتِي تَحُمُّهُمُ، وَهِيَ تَحَمُّدٌ لِلسَّلامِ وَتَهَنُّدٌ لِلشُكْرِ، وَهِيَ تَنَظَّرُ حَقِيقَةَ الصَّفا وَتُفَضِّلُ رَكَبَ النَدَواتِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ الأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي تَطَوُّلُ إِلَيهَا العَزائمُ

in_urdu.name: آسجاد
in_urdu.meaning: اسماں جو سلام تے ترقی کے حالات کے لئے متعلق ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسلام اور ترقی کے حالات کے لئے متعلق اسماں جو رذائل پر غلبہ حاصل کرنے اور جباری اور شاکر کے لئے تصنیف کرنے کا حامی ہوتا ہے، اس سے نُوَعین کا احترام ہوتا ہے، اس میں سلام اور شکر کا حمد ہوتا ہے، اس میں صفا کی حقیقت کو دیکھنا ہوتا ہے اور نادوٹوں کے رکاب کو فضیلت دینا ہوتا ہے، اس سے عزمات کا طویلہ ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: आसजाद
in_hindi.meaning: सलाम और तेज़ी के हालातों के लिए संबंधित नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम सलाम और तेज़ी के हालातों के लिए संबंधित है, जो रذिलों पर जीत हासिल करने और जबारी और शाक्र के लिए निर्माण करने का समर्थन करता है, यह दो नुओएिन का सम्मान करता है, इसमें सलाम और शुक्र का शुक्रिया अदा करना होता है, इसमें सच्चाई की सच्चाई को देखना होता है और नाडोआटी के र्कब को महत्व देना होता है, यह अन्यायों का लंबा होता है

in_pashto.name: آسجاد
in_pashto.meaning: سلام او ترقیو کي حالاتو ته کليس

data.cultural_impact: The name Asjad is of Arabic origin and is associated with the brave, strong, and resilient. The cultural significance lies in the fact that it is a noble name that signifies one who stands up and defends against injustice, oppression, and harm to others. This name inspires courage and instills a sense of duty to protect the weak and innocent in society.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Asjad holds significant meaning as it relates to the concept of being a guardian and protector of one's faith, moral values, and beliefs. This name reflects the idea that each individual has a responsibility to safeguard the moral and spiritual well-being of themselves and those around them. The spiritual significance of the name Asjad is a reminder of the importance of staying steadfast in faith and standing up for truth, justice, and righteousness. It urges individuals to be vigilant and to protect the innocence and purity that lies within the human soul.
